description_en: Queries the list of pay-as-you-go site plans available for purchase by a user
description_zh: 查询用户可购买的后付费站点套餐列表
name: ListPostpaidSitePlans

PageSize.description_en: The page size. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 500. Valid values: any integer from 1 to 500
PageSize.description_zh: 分页大小，默认20，最大500，取值：1~500之前的任意整数

BillingMethod.description_en:
The billable methods of the plan. Valid values:
dps_month95: monthly 95th percentile billing method
BillingMethod.description_zh:
套餐的计费方式，支持：
dps_month95：月95计费方式

BillingMode.description_en:
The payment type. Valid values:

PREPAY: subscription.
POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go
BillingMode.description_zh:
付费类型。支持：

PREPAY：预付费。
POSTPAY：后付费

Coverages.description_en:
The acceleration regions to which sites can be added under the plan. Multiple values are separated by commas (,). Valid values:

domestic: the Chinese mainland.
overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland).
global: global (including the Chinese mainland)
Coverages.description_zh:
套餐内可以添加的站点的加速区域范围，多个用（,）隔开。取值：

domestic：国内。
overseas：全球（不包含国内）。
global：全球（包含国内）

PlanName.description_en: The name of the plan, which serves as a unique identifier in English
PlanName.description_zh: 套餐的名称，使用英文进行唯一标识

PlanType.description_en:
The plan type of the plan instance. Valid values:
normal: fixed edition plan.
enterprise: enterprise edition plan
PlanType.description_zh:
套餐实例对应的套餐类型，取值：
normal：固定版套餐。
enterprise：企业版套餐

SaleStatus.description_en:
The sale status of the plan. Valid values for enterprise edition plans:

saled: sold.
upgrading: specification change in progress
SaleStatus.description_zh:
套餐的售卖状态，企业版套餐支持：

saled：已售卖。
upgrading：变配中
